record.question: Factors increasing a drug's dialysability are all except:
record.explanation: Answer C: Large volume of distribution (Vd). Low protein binding, low molecular weight, and limited distribution volume generally favor dialytic removal; a large volume of distribution moves drug into tissues and reduces the fraction accessible in plasma. Reference: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/10560800/; https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/6851257/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
